_comment: Presentation metadata for the federal rules we track, keyed by regulations.gov document id. Lifecycle data (deadline, comment URLs, final rule) comes from a puzzle's comment_cta where one exists — this file never duplicates it. Entries carrying their own urls/deadline are rules we cover WITHOUT a puzzle CTA.

OMB-2026-0034-0001.title: Regulation for Federal Financial Assistance
OMB-2026-0034-0001.summary: The biggest rewrite of how federal grant money works in over a decade — $1.1 trillion a year across 40-plus agencies. Flexible guidance becomes binding law, without a vote in Congress.

DOJ-OAG-2026-0001-0001.title: Ethical Standards for Attorneys for the Government
DOJ-OAG-2026-0001-0001.summary: Would let Justice Department lawyers opt out of the state bar rules that bind every other attorney — the department policing its own ethics.
